job.title: Backend Software Engineer
job.summary: Build reliable APIs, PostgreSQL-backed services, background workers, and AI-assisted products.

bullets.text: Built an LLM-powered job analysis and resume tailoring platform with server-enforced grounding: proposed edits are rejected unless their cited evidence belongs to the user and was retrieved during the same agent run.
Designed a FastAPI backend with Supabase and REST APIs for event creation, updates, and geocoded location storage; integrated it with a React/TypeScript calendar and Mapbox interface.
Worked on the PostgreSQL backend and database functionality using psycopg2, full-text search, locking, and indexes to support application data and resume matching.
answers: Built PostgreSQL-backed storage and queries with psycopg2 for resume, job, and tailoring data. Added normalized skill lookups, full-text search, composite indexes, and database-backed claim and lease fields.

bullets.text: Improved background processing for longer tailoring tasks so they could run more reliably and recover when something went wrong.
answers: Moved long-running tailoring work out of the Flask web process into a separate worker service. Added database-backed job claiming, lease expiration, retry and recovery handling, and idempotency so interrupted jobs can be reclaimed without duplicate LLM work.

bullets.text: Implemented reserve-before-spend idempotency for job-draft creation so duplicate requests cannot trigger duplicate LLM calls, with stored-response replay after completion.
Helped customers choose running shoes and handled weekend register closeout.

job.title: Robotics Software Engineer
job.summary: Develop C++ perception and controls software for autonomous vehicles using ROS 2 and LiDAR.

bullets.text: Contributing to a work-in-progress ROS 2 autonomous-driving stack in C++ for Pitt's FSAE EV driverless program, focused on cone-perception software.
answers: Worked on the ROS 2 cone-perception pipeline in C++, including LiDAR point-cloud processing, ground removal, Euclidean clustering, cone validation and centroid estimation, plus LiDAR-to-camera projection for camera-based cone color classification.

bullets.text: Working on Velodyne VLP-16 point-cloud filtering, ground removal, Euclidean clustering, cone validation and centroid estimation, and LiDAR-to-camera projection with camera-based cone-color classification.
answers: Implemented the VLP-16 processing stages that remove ground points, cluster remaining points with Euclidean clustering, filter candidate clusters, and estimate cone centroids.

bullets.text: Implemented a C++ steering controller that converts planned curvature into rack commands and clamps output against the vehicle's measured steering limits.
Calibrated LiDAR-to-camera transforms and verified projection error against labelled cone images before track testing.
Helped develop software for an autonomous vehicle using C++ and ROS 2.
answers: Implemented the ROS 2 node that validates cone clusters and publishes centroid detections to the planning stack.

bullets.text: Sold team merchandise at race events and tracked cash totals in a spreadsheet.

answers: Rewrote the address-validation step and its API endpoint in Python.

bullets.text: Created backend functionality to manage users, messages, and channels for ChatRoom.

bullets.text: Designed the PostgreSQL schema for jobs, resumes, and tailoring runs, including composite indexes for owner-scoped lookups.
Added integration tests for lease expiry and worker recovery, including a killed-worker case that proves interrupted jobs can be reclaimed.
Adjusted CSS spacing and colors on a marketing landing page.
